title: Potted Plant Cover 3-Pack – Protection Against Wind, Rain and Frost
seo_title: Potted Plant Cover 3-Pack – Protection Against Wind, Rain, Frost
seo_description: 3 covers in garden fleece, 120 × 180 cm, with zipper and drawstring. Protection against wind, rain, snow and frost according to the packaging.
descriptionHtml:
The frost comes before you've had time to think about the pots

The evenings get colder faster than you expected, and the potted plants are still outside just like last summer. You think 'I'll bring them in this weekend' — and with every evening that goes by it gets colder before you've gotten to it.

3 covers that shield the plant from wind, rain, snow and frost

Three covers in garden fleece, 120 × 180 cm, with zipper and drawstring at the bottom — according to the packaging's own labeling, protection against wind, rain, snow and frost. Pull one over the pot and close it, with no need to lift everything off again.

Features

  • 3 covers in the pack – covers several potted plants at once, not just one
  • Protection against wind, rain, snow and frost – printed on the packaging's own labeling
  • The zipper makes it easy to peek in – without lifting off the whole cover
  • Tightened with a drawstring at the bottom – the cord holds the cover in place around the pot
  • 120 × 180 cm per cover – fits plants of different sizes and heights

The lifestyle images are AI-generated illustrations.

Our guarantee

14 days to change your mind – if you don't like it, you get your money back. Tracked delivery and secure checkout. 🦫
